description: This source file defines the internal class 'ProxyGenerator' within the Orleans code generator framework. The class is responsible for generating proxy classes (RPC stubs called invokers) for interfaces, including creating class declarations, fields, constructors, and proxy methods that handle asynchronous invocation logic for RPC calls.

classes.name: ProxyGenerator
classes.description: Internal class responsible for generating RPC proxy classes for interfaces, including creating class declarations, fields, constructors, and methods for RPC invocation, supporting asynchronous patterns.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a proxy class declaration and description based on the provided interface description, including class name, base types, attributes, fields, constructors, and proxy methods.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a sanitized simple class name for the proxy class based on the interface description.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates field declaration syntax nodes from field descriptions.

methods.name: CreateProxyMethods
methods.description: Creates the proxy method implementations for each method in the interface description, supporting asynchronous patterns and explicit interface implementation.

methods.name: CreateAsyncProxyMethodBody
methods.description: Builds the body of an asynchronous proxy method, handling request creation, parameter copying, invocation, and result handling.

methods.name: GenerateConstructors
methods.description: Generates constructors for the proxy class, including calls to base class constructors if applicable, and initializes fields.

methods.name: GetParameterSyntax
methods.description: Creates syntax nodes for method parameters with appropriate ref/out/in modifiers.
